summary: Instinct bridge, PR 1 (contract and durable records), behind the staged flag instinct_bridge (INSTINCT_BRIDGE_ENABLED in src/shared/bridge.ts, false; SB_INSTINCT_BRIDGE=1 or the backend setting labs.instinct_bridge turns it on; no capability is advertised until the tools ship). src/shared/bridge.ts holds the wire version (1), the seven tool names (search_chats, list_projects, list_recent_chats, start_chat, send_to_chat, read_chat, stop_chat), the three mutating operations, the project policy {project_id, label, machine_id, canonical_local_root, allowed_agents, default_agent, default_model, default_mode, maximum_mode, actions} with defaults auto capped at auto, edit and checks on, commit, push, PR, merge and deploy off, the public project view without the local root, the opaque chat reference {machine_id, chat_id}, the call delivery, chat work, stop and evidence states, the 19 error codes with a structured error and retry advice, the mode check that refuses a mode above the cap instead of changing it, and a canonical input hash for idempotency. An additive migration adds bridge_project_policies (with a revision raised on each save), bridge_calls (unique on operation and idempotency key, with input hash, call id, machine, resolved target, policy revision, state, rejection detail and timestamps; after 90 days a tombstone keeps key, hash and call id, and its key answers request_retired), bridge_origins (one per root chat, resolved through resolveRootThreadId, stamped with the stop generation) and bridge_stop_generation (one monotonic row). src/main/db/bridge.ts reserves calls in an immediate transaction under the call id the relay reserved (or a new one for a local call), moves call states only forward, retires expired calls, recovers calls caught mid-flight at start (recorded becomes rejected with confirmed non-delivery, dispatching becomes delivery_unknown), records and reads origins and reads and advances the stop generation. Settings > Labs gains an Instinct bridge row with a warning that Instinct acts as the owner in allowed projects. Nothing calls these records yet: no relay, no tools and no executable bridge path ship in this part. PR 2 (local read tools): with the flag on, Settings > Labs lists the sidebar projects with a checkbox each (none checked by default); a checked project is saved as a bridge policy under its realpath with the default policy, on this desktop's machine id (the existing hub.installId row), through the admin-scoped bridge:list-projects and bridge:set-project-allowed channels. The Switchboard MCP server gives every local agent list_projects, list_recent_chats, search_chats and read_chat (src/main/bridge/read-service.ts, src/main/mcp/bridge-tools.ts), listed only while the flag is on and refused with bridge_disabled once it is off. The allowlist is applied in SQL before ranking and limits on both the FTS and the fallback message-search path; title matches merge with message hits into one row per root chat (matched_on title, message or both) under the existing word-prefix and archive-word rules; snippets are plain text of at most 240 characters with saved secrets masked; read_chat returns measured status, the latest reply with a partial marker while a turn runs, pending questions and approvals, a bounded masked history window and an opaque since cursor bound to chat, machine and policy revision (unchanged: true or cursor_expired); labels resolve exact id, then exact normalized label, then bounded word-prefix fuzzy, and several plausible matches give ambiguous_target with choices. No answer carries a local path. Results are local only (partial false, no unavailable machines) and evidence is not_measured until the measured-check service. Global search is unchanged.
